nodes.rationale: .claude/rules with paths frontmatter does not exist in Claude Code and fails silently; subdirectory CLAUDE.md loads only when files in that tree are touched.

nodes.rationale: What can be asked goes in CLAUDE.md; what must be enforced is a hook, run by the harness not decided by the model.

nodes.label: Chicago School (inside-out, state verification)
nodes.rationale: Use when the result is what matters: domain logic, calculations, rules, state machines.

nodes.label: Irtas teszt (deletion test)
nodes.rationale: If removing a line causes no error, the line is unnecessary; keeps CLAUDE.md under 100 lines.

nodes.label: London School (outside-in, interaction verification)
nodes.rationale: Use when the question is whether a side effect happened at all: HTTP, email, payment, LLM calls.

nodes.label: Skill frontmatter (disable-model-invocation, allowed-tools)
nodes.rationale: disable-model-invocation is mandatory for side-effecting procedures so the model does not commit on its own.

nodes.label: reviewer subagent (read-only diff review)
nodes.rationale: A fresh reader who did not see the reasoning spots what the author misses; reports only correctness/spec issues (max 8) to avoid over-engineering from review findings.

nodes.rationale: Fixes doing steps in a different order every time and ending without evidence.

nodes.label: /spec skill (interview then write docs/SPEC.md)
nodes.rationale: Large vague tasks drift mid-way; the spec is the scope contract.
